M1.reason: Measured overlap clears 0.80 in every view (front/back 0.919, left/right 0.852, top/below 0.806), but parts of the outline differ. Seen from the top, the original's box has a recessed, sloped notch cut into the front of the top face, and its strap hangs as a loose, uneven loop off the front-left. The reproduction has a flat top with no notch, and its strap is a neat symmetric loop coming off both sides. In the left and right views the reproduction's strap tapers along the floor as a wedge, where the original's strap is a long flat band of even height.

M2.reason: Length 34.6 vs 34.6 and width 26.4 vs 26.4 match exactly. Height is 7.0 vs 6.8, about 3% over, well within 10%.

M3.reason: The chamfered box, carry strap and control panel are all there, but two are the wrong shape or in the wrong place. The original's panel (dark screen, red/green lights, round dial) sits sunk into a sloped cutout at the front of the top. The reproduction's panel is a flat decal on the top surface. The original's short sides each carry a dark block at the front end with two round speaker/dial fittings. The reproduction has only a small black square on each side. The strap is attached and routed differently: the original's comes off the front-left in an uneven loop, the reproduction's is symmetric.

M4.reason: The broad regions are the same kind of colour: off-white painted metal, red cross and lettering, dark panel, khaki strap. But the measured mean colour difference is 29, well over 15. The original's strap is a grey-brown noisy check, the reproduction's is a smoother, lighter tan. The reproduction's white is brighter and cleaner than the original's grey, worn white.

But the reproduction is crisp and clean where the original is low-resolution and noisy with wear. The original's small red arrow text along the sides is reduced to plain red lines. The original's screen sits in the recessed cutout, so it reads differently from the reproduction's flat screen.

M6.reason: At game size it reads as the same kind of object, a white first-aid kit with a red cross and a strap. Side by side, though, the clean bright texture, the flat panel where the original has a recessed cutout, and the lighter, symmetric strap would make a player see a different model.

M7.reason: The front (the panel side) faces the same way as in the original, the model is upright, and it sits flat at the same base height with the same footprint centred.

M8.reason: SMAK's check passes with no errors and nothing looks open, inside out or floating. But it has 712 triangles against the original's 99, about 7 times the original and far over the 2x limit (198).
